description: Analytics summary panel for the active Notion space and page.

parameters.name: AnalyticsProvider
parameters.description: Analytics provider used to query page views and top pages.

parameters.name: CurrentPageId
parameters.description: Currently open page id used for the main analytics summary.

parameters.name: OnClosed
parameters.description: Raised when the close button is clicked.

parameters.name: SpaceId
parameters.description: Space whose top pages should be displayed.

parameters.name: TopPageCount
parameters.description: Maximum number of top pages to show.
